content.value: Water at 20°C (p = 998 kg/m3 and $\mu = 1 5 . 4 0 \times 1 0 ^ { - 4 }$ kg/m.s) is flowing steadily through a 3 mm diameter and 9 m long horizontal pipe at an average velocity of 1.1 rn/sec. Determine: (i) the head loss, (ii) the pressure drop, and (iii) the pumping power required to overcome this pressure drop.
